attack.note: Basic attacks are weak. Celestial Alignment adds 85 percent damage to autos on Moonfire revealed targets but is a situational pick.

poke.note: Moonfire is 90 damage for 10 Mana on a 3 second cooldown, mostly used to trigger Regrowth healing and to reveal. Vengeful Roots Treant adds modest single target damage. Measured 894 hero damage per minute.

damage.note: Damage exists to power Moonfire healing, not to kill.

healing.note: Regrowth is 380 over 20 seconds on up to three or four allies, and Moonfire pays a 130 instant heal to every Regrowth ally for each enemy hit, at any distance. That is excellent sustain and good AoE with Tranquility (80 per second for 8 seconds) but weak against single target burst, since the healing is spread out. Wild Growth and Nature's Balance keep Regrowth running. Serenity and Lunar Shower scale healing in long fights.

good_into.why: Regrowth is a 20 second heal over time on several allies and Tranquility plus Serenity covers AoE damage. Long chip damage that a burst healer cannot cover is his best matchup.
Entangling Roots follows up any crowd control on clumped melee Heroes, Emerald Dreams extends it with sleep, and Twilight Dream silence shuts down melee abilities for 3 seconds.
Nature's Cure removes stuns, roots and slows from every ally with Regrowth, at unlimited range. It does not give Unstoppable.
Roots and Hindering Moonfire slow punish dashers who commit, and Regrowth heals divers wherever they go because Moonfire heal ignores distance.

bad_into.why: Regrowth spreads healing over 20 seconds, so a focused dive kills before it ticks. He has no escape and his own Regrowth needs Rejuvenation to be useful on himself.
Low mobility and a squishy body with no Unstoppable. Assassins who cut through the frontline remove the healer first.
Hard to hit Moonfire and Roots on Heroes that stay at range, so Regrowth healing from Moonfire dries up and his low damage cannot punish them.

wants_from_team: Allies who protect him from dive
Mana hungry or cooldown reliant Heroes for Innervate, such as casters
Crowd control to chain with Entangling Roots
gives_team: Sustain healing that scales through long fights
Innervate mana and cooldown speed up
weaknesses: Silence cannot be cleansed and he cannot give Unstoppable
Moonfire healing needs enemies in range
evidence: Regrowth, Moonfire, Entangling Roots, Tranquility, Twilight Dream, Innervate ability text
Wild Growth, Nature's Balance, Moonlit Harmony, Serenity, Lunar Shower, Nature's Cure talent text
Icy Veins role in current meta says counter to comps with two or fewer assassins
